projects.description: We built a product-focused website for PACTIVA Energy, bringing its lithium battery catalogue, technical product information, and B2B enquiry journey together in one place. The website combines WordPress and WooCommerce with custom functionality for product discovery, quotation summaries, and WhatsApp enquiries.

projects.overview: PACTIVA Energy (Pactiva Energy Tech India Pvt Ltd) is an industrial clean-tech and lithium battery manufacturing enterprise based in Sector 65, Noida. The company manufactures and supplies Grade-A lithium-ion and LiFePO4 cells, active balancing Smart BMS modules (DALY, JK), solar energy storage systems (ESS), and electric vehicle (EV) battery packs to commercial integrators and industrial clients across India. Nexnify engineered a focused digital platform combining WordPress content flexibility with a customized WooCommerce catalogue, enabling business customers to explore technical battery specifications, compile quotation lists, and initiate direct sales consultations without navigating a cumbersome consumer checkout.
projects.challenge: Presenting a broad and varied technical product catalogue—spanning raw 3.2V 280Ah LiFePO4 prismatic cells, active balancers, high-current DC fuses, and multi-protocol CAN/RS485 Smart BMS units—presented distinct structural challenges. Standard retail e-commerce checkouts are ill-suited for industrial B2B transactions, where buyers require bulk quotation terms, custom terminal arrangements, and engineering review rather than credit card payment gateways. The platform needed to organize complex battery products into logical categories, display critical specifications (voltage, capacity, discharge C-ratings, communication protocols) with absolute clarity, and provide a frictionless bridge between technical discovery and direct WhatsApp quotation enquiries.
projects.approach: We structured the platform using WordPress and WooCommerce, customized specifically around a B2B enquiry workflow rather than a conventional transactional store. Custom PHP modules were built to transform the shopping cart into an itemized quotation summary interface, while maintaining a secure database-backed log of customer requests on the server. To bridge product exploration with immediate commercial conversations, we engineered preformatted WhatsApp deep-links that automatically append product SKUs, selected quantities, and user requirements, delivering qualified leads directly to the PACTIVA technical sales desk.
whatWasBuilt: Dynamic WooCommerce catalogue managing LiFePO4 cells, Smart BMS hardware, and solar ESS systems
B2B quotation summary interface replacing consumer checkout with formal quotation requests
Preformatted WhatsApp inquiry integration routing product SKUs and quantities to sales engineers
Database-backed custom lead capture to record enquiry submissions securely in MySQL
Detailed technical specification tables showcasing cell voltage, discharge ratings, and BMS communication protocols
Mobile-first responsive architecture tested for desktop, tablet, and smartphone field browsing

projects.overview: XChat is an independently developed, feature-rich mobile messaging application engineered to deliver a seamless real-time communication experience. faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Honest answers to common questions about working together.

items.question: What do you need to start a project?
items.answer: A brief overview of your business or idea, your preferred timeline, any reference sites you admire, and any existing content or brand assets you have. If you don't have everything ready, we can help define the structure during discovery.

items.question: How long does a website take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on scope and complexity. A focused landing page typically takes 1 to 2 weeks, while a multi-page business website generally takes 2 to 4 weeks from initial concept to launch.

items.question: Can you work with an existing design?
items.answer: Yes. If you already have Figma designs, wireframes, or brand guidelines, we can translate them into high-quality, pixel-accurate, responsive code.

items.question: Can you integrate APIs?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate REST APIs, third-party forms, CMS platforms, analytics, and other services required by your web project.

items.question: Do you provide website maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We offer post-launch support and ongoing maintenance to keep your website updated, secure, and running smoothly.
